title: Raising of Jairus’ Daughter
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the raising of Jairus' daughter (Mark 5:35-43), lists lessons and says Jesus has power over life and death.

floor.question: Name a person Jesus healed.
floor.answer: The man with a withered hand

contexts: a family praying for a relative

board.do: Wait for the child to say little girl, get up.
Write the lessons and "power over life and death".

misconceptions.ask: What had happened to Jairus' daughter when Jesus arrived?
misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 5:35. Say gently: she had died, and Jesus brought her back to life.
Read Mark 5:42 and write 12 on the board.

misconceptions.ask: Which disciples did Jesus take with him?
misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 5:37 and hold up three name cards.

listen_for: Go home, it is too late
misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus tell Jairus when the messengers came?
